items.text: Cincinnati (final, Sat): OUT - RG Dalton Risner (knees; Jalen Rivers starts). DOUBTFUL - WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb) and CB Jalen Davis (hamstring), both pending IR activation. QUESTIONABLE - LG Dylan Fairchild (oblique, full Sat), CB Dax Hill (illness, no practice but Taylor expects him to play), S Kyle Dugger (quad, full Fri), LB Swayze Bozeman and G Brian Parker II (IR returns). LB Oren Burks (groin) to IR. Joe Burrow (illness) full Thu/Fri, no designation, starts.

Washington (Sat): QUESTIONABLE - RB Rachaad White (heel, DNP Sat), CB Amik Robertson (ankle, new Sat DNP), RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin, needs IR activation), C Lucas Patrick (concussion, 'good to go'). S Quan Martin and WR Treylon Burks no designation. Nick Allegretti expected at C. IR - DT Daron Payne, WR Terry McLaurin, OT Laremy Tunsil, LB Leo Chenal. Jayden Daniels (elbow) full all week, starts. Final statuses due Monday.
